title: Prompt model-version sources must be a placeholder or a validated remote URI
answers: prompt registration accepts a local path as the model version source
register prompt with a relative or drive-letter source then get-artifact serves server files
schemeless source bypasses path validation for prompt model versions
CreateModelVersion prompt source path traversal bypass
body:
Symptom: a prompt registered with a local-looking source (e.g. "mlflow", "etc", "C:/Windows") is accepted, and get-artifact for that model version then serves files from the server's local filesystem.
Root cause: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_create_model_version prompt branch blocked only file:// and leading "/", and ran the traversal check only when urlparse found a scheme. Schemeless values reached LocalArtifactRepository unvalidated.
Fix pattern: route every prompt source through mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source. Classify with get_uri_scheme (not urlparse, so drive letters count as local). Non-file schemes get the traversal check. Schemeless sources pass only on an exact match with mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS.
Constraints: matching is exact, with no case folding, trailing-slash stripping or percent-decoding. Which remote schemes are allowed is a separate, pre-existing question that also applies to non-prompt versions, so it is not restricted here.
applies: Any change to source validation for prompt-tagged CreateModelVersion requests or to the prompt placeholder allowlist.
says: Users can read sensitive server files by registering prompts with relative or local system paths.
Downloading artifacts for a registered prompt exposes files from the underlying host file system.
Reject prompt versions that specify local drive letters or relative file paths as their source.
Only permit approved placeholder keywords or validated remote addresses when registering new prompt templates.
The model registry allows path traversal attacks through schemeless prompt source locations.
search: Prompt sources in CreateModelVersion must be validated through mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_prompt_source to prevent path traversal and arbitrary local server file disclosure via get-artifact. Source URIs are classified using mlflow/utils/uri.py:get_uri_scheme rather than urlparse, ensuring drive letters count as local. Schemeless sources must match mlflow/prompt/constants.py:_PROMPT_SOURCE_PLACEHOLDERS exactly without case folding, trailing slash stripping, or percent decoding, while non-file schemes undergo traversal validation.
